comparisons.name: corner-top-light
comparisons.description: Top-right corner of the window over the desktop, Aqua: the 4 pt radius, the borderless edge and the shadow. The video frame is masked except for the 4 pt square at the corner, where the frame is close to one dark colour, so the edges are scored from outside and the corner from both sides; the sky behind is a colour ramp fitted to the Desktop capture.

comparisons.name: corner-top-dark
comparisons.description: Top-right corner of the window over the desktop, Dark Aqua. Masked as corner-top-light.

comparisons.name: corner-bottom-light
comparisons.description: Bottom-right corner of the window and its shadow over the desktop, Aqua. The video frame is masked; the sea behind is a colour ramp fitted to the Desktop capture, so the picture's grain remains in the score.

comparisons.name: corner-bottom-dark
comparisons.description: Bottom-right corner of the window and its shadow over the desktop, Dark Aqua. Masked as corner-bottom-light.

comparisons.name: idle-light
comparisons.description: The window with the pointer away: no scrim and no controls over the video, Aqua.

pixels.note: the example's grey stand-in for the video, at the middle of the window: no control is shown (measured: the capture shows none)
where the close button would be
the screen beside the window, which is 320 pt wide and 20 pt from the right edge

comparisons.name: hover-light
comparisons.description: The window under the pointer, which rests on the middle button: scrim and the three controls, Aqua. No screenshot shows it; the values are the spec's inference from AVKit.

pixels.note: scrim, black at 50%, over the grey stand-in; inferred
middle of the close glyph, 10 + 14 pt from the window's top-left corner: white; inferred
inside the close button beside its glyph: no fill while the pointer is elsewhere
a bar of the pause glyph in the 44 pt middle button: white; inferred
the middle button under the pointer: white at 20% over the scrim; inferred

comparisons.name: hover-dark
comparisons.description: The window under the pointer, Dark Aqua: the same scrim and controls as in Aqua.

pixels.note: scrim, black at 50%, over the grey stand-in; inferred
a bar of the pause glyph: white; inferred
the screen beside the window

comparisons.name: focus-light

pixels.note: scrim over the grey stand-in: focus inside shows the controls; inferred
focus ring, 3 pt outside the 28 pt close button: --mac-focus-ring-color (24 106 246 at 50%) over the scrim; inferred
middle of the close glyph
